title: Spectral Recording of Gene Expression History by Fluorescent Timer Protein
author: Anna R. Tröscher
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8jvhun6
materials: You can now analyze the images with any software of choice (e.g. ImagePro Premier, ImageJ,…). For the calculations: a separate standard curve has the be performed for every independent experiment. When standard curve parameters are set, the cells of interest can be evaluated according to the mathematical approach described in detail in the guidelines section.

steps.title: Prepare HeLa Cells
steps.instruction: Grow HeLa cells on a 6-well plate to approximately 80% confluency.

substeps.instruction: Use standard medium (DMEM + 10% FCS + 1% Pen/Strep + 1% L-Glutamine).
Incubate overnight at 37.5 °C and 5% CO2.

steps.title: Transfect Cells
steps.instruction: Transfect cells using TransIT-LT1 reagent according to the manufacturer's instructions.

substeps.instruction: Add TransIT-LT1 reagent to 1 µg/µl plasmid in Opti-MEM I reduced serum medium.
Incubate the mixture for 30 minutes at room temperature.
Add the reagent to the cells and incubate for 24 hours.

steps.title: Post-Transfection Wash
steps.instruction: Remove the transfection reagent and refresh the medium.

substeps.instruction: Remove medium containing the transfection reagent.
Wash cells with PBS.
Add fresh standard medium.

steps.title: Cell Recovery
steps.instruction: Leave cells undisturbed until induction (48 hours recommended).

steps.title: Induce Gene Expression (FACS Option)
steps.instruction: Induce cells with TPA, ensuring strict safety precautions as TPA is highly carcinogenic and volatile.

substeps.instruction: Grow +TPA and -TPA cells in separate 6-well plates to prevent cross-contamination.
Incubate cells for 40 minutes with 100 ng/ml TPA diluted in standard medium.
Carefully remove all TPA and remove medium from -TPA cells.
Wash with PBS.

steps.title: Harvest Cells for FACS
steps.instruction: Collect cells for fluorescence and cell number determination.

substeps.instruction: Add approximately 2 mL of trypsin until cells are detached from the plate.
Add 2 mL of standard medium to deactivate trypsin.
Pellet cells by centrifugation.
Resuspend in PBS.

steps.title: Perform FACS Analysis
steps.instruction: Measure fluorescence and cell number using FACS at chosen time points.

substeps.instruction: Recommended time points: every two hours for the first 9 hours and again at 24 hours post-induction.
Analyze data using a standard FACS analysis program (e.g., FlowJo).

steps.title: Prepare Cells for Life-Cell Imaging
steps.instruction: Transfer cells to chambered cell culture slides 24 hours after transfection.

substeps.instruction: Determine seeding density accounting for cell growth, as cells will remain on slides for another 48 hours.
Let cells rest in the incubator on the slides for 24 hours.

steps.title: Induce Gene Expression (LCI Option)
steps.instruction: Induce cells with TPA using protective gear and precautions against volatility.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 ng/ml TPA diluted in standard cell culture medium.
Cover -TPA wells with parafilm to prevent accidental induction.
Incubate cells with TPA for 40 minutes.
Remove all medium (including from -TPA cells), wash with PBS, and add fresh medium.

steps.title: Perform Life-Cell Imaging
steps.instruction: Image cells using a fluorescent microscope capable of life-cell imaging over 24 hours.

substeps.instruction: Recommended imaging frequency: every hour.
